Heard once and fortuitously recorded.  It sounds somewhat like Thripadectes melanorhynchus to me, but goes substantially faster than the fastest examples of T. melanorhynchus that I can find, e.g. https://macaulaylibrary.org/asset/140533).  Hope I'm not overlooking something obvious.

Edit: see discussion for details--ultimately I believe that this very likely to indeed be T. melanorhynchus.
